newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: U.S. embassy in Paraguay threatened.
newsitem.headline: U.S. embassy in Paraguay threatened.

text.p: The U.S. embassy in Paraguay said on Tuesday it was suspending all public celebrations of the U.S. presidential election after receiving a "terrorist threat."
"We have received information about a terrorist threat against the U.S. government in Asuncion," the embassy said in a statement in Spanish.
The mission cancelled plans to celebrate the results of the U.S. presidential vote on Tuesday. Paraguayan authorities tightened security around the embassy.

"We recommend everyone to be cautious when visiting facilities of the United States of America (in Asuncion) or taking part in activities sponsored by the U.S. government," the brief statement said. It was not immediately clear what kind of threat was made or how the embassy received the information.

An embassy spokesman declined to provide details but suggested the mission premises were not necessarily the target. "The threat is against an official facility of our government in Asuncion," he said, promising more information after an investigation.
